siegeSays.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The drumbeat with no drummer stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
🗣️ A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands to a man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan, by the fire: "Stone. We need 56 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
The drumbeat with no drummer stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)

◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Choir Toad, Drum-Belly, Flashbulb Moth, Highbeam Deer) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
📓 Codex: Bill proposed relief (raid), day 14.

◈ SYSTEM: "PALISADE: ONLINE. Pointy! The audience approves of pointy. Raiders will think twice — the ones that can think. Sleep easy, little ones. The walls are watching so you do not have to."
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
🍽️ Katarina lingers by the full pantry and laughs. "Full shelves, full bellies. Mending the palisade today — the fence won't fix itself."

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Hushpuppy, Nevermore, Hushpuppy, Headlight Harry) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
The watch holds the wall. You sleep through the worst of it — or would have, if the shouting had let you.
